t0.text: Round 3 · Personal Life OS — pure black, Opal-led, built around your real day

t1.text: Round 2 · “Night Stone” (too corporate — kept for comparison)

t2.text: Round 2 · Focus, light variant, behavior prototype

s1.text:
What changed from round 2 (layout, not just paint):
1. Navi talks in every workspace — a sentence at the top of each page, written like Joi (“4 left today. The essay’s the big one.”), plus inline suggestions you can accept or wave off.
2. Tasks group by time of day (morning / afternoon / evening / anytime), like Things — not by status like a tracker.
3. One line of context per task, in human words (“before Friday”), instead of columns.
4. Life spaces instead of projects: School, Health, Home, Hobbies, Friends, Work.
5. Planner is a vertical day you live through — wake, class, run, dinner, wind down — with free time called out and Navi offering to fill it.
6. Pure black (#000) with Opal-style glass surfaces; one friendly typeface (Figtree).

s2.text:
Your calls:
• Does the sentence-at-the-top voice feel like Navi, or too chatty?
• Time-of-day grouping for Tasks: yes / no?
• Spaces list in the sidebar: the right set?
• Planner: vertical day only, or keep a 3-day / week grid as a second view?
